description.value: Whytecliff Marine Protected Area is a coastal park and dive destination in West Vancouver, widely recognized as one of Canada's first marine protected areas. Managed by the District of West Vancouver, it protects a rich underwater ecosystem popular with scuba divers and snorkellers. The park sits at the end of the Horseshoe Bay peninsula and offers dramatic cliff-top views of Howe Sound, making it a scenic detour for touring cyclists on the Sea to Sky corridor.
